title: Concept: go.sum records a non-standard hash prefix
description: go.sum declares a checksum file in which no line carries the expected `h1:` hash, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Go only enforces the `h1:` directory hash, so lines in another format are either ignored or rejected rather than verified.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.sum (go).
risk: Go only enforces the `h1:` directory hash, so lines in another format are either ignored or rejected rather than verified.
